checkpoint.license_access_qualification: The official OpenVLA repository states that its code is MIT but pretrained Llama-2-derived models inherit the Llama Community License; retain both notices and obtain owner/legal approval before redistribution or commercial use.

adapter_contract.upstream_loading: transformers.AutoProcessor.from_pretrained and AutoModelForVision2Seq.from_pretrained with trust_remote_code=True, revision pinned

input.prompt_template: In: What action should the robot take to {task_description_lower}?\nOut:
input.image: RGB camera image; optional center crop to 90% area then resize to 224x224 for this randomly-cropped fine-tuned checkpoint

output.normalized_action: 7-vector (x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw, gripper)
output.postprocessing: normalize gripper to [-1,1], binarize, then invert gripper sign before LIBERO env.step
output.environment_action: 7 finite values passed as a list to env.step

adapter_contract.representation_capture: A future adapter must observe the official generate/predict_action path and preserve generated action token IDs plus a declared internal hidden-state capture point; no generic ModelAdapter or existing ACT/Diffusion/SmolVLA adapter proves OpenVLA.

acceptance.task_success_reference: OpenVLA paper reports 84.7 +/- 0.9% on LIBERO-Spatial over 3 seeds x 500 rollouts; execute 500 trials for this lane.
acceptance.causal_control: paired no-intervention and declared internal-representation intervention on identical seeds/initial states; zero-strength identity must be exact and non-zero intervention must pass an owner-frozen effect threshold before execution
acceptance.promotion: D3 requires real checkpoint execution, causal artifact, revision manifest, and validator-clean evidence; this config is not evidence.

runtime.hardware_reference: NVIDIA A100 GPU; upstream evaluation used A100 and fine-tuning used 8 x A100 80GB
runtime.minimum_evidence_host: CUDA-capable host with sufficient VRAM for a 7.5B-parameter bfloat16 checkpoint; use the upstream A100 80GB profile for the first lane run
runtime.network_policy: network opt-in only; download pinned model and dataset into disposable isolated caches
runtime.cleanup: remove disposable clone, model/data caches, and rollout logs after preserving signed artifact

blocker.exact: No OpenVLA checkpoint is cached locally, LATENT_ANYTHING_RUN_NETWORK is not enabled, no HF token is configured (public Hub access is non-gated), and this Windows host has no CUDA device. The repository has no OpenVLA adapter/capture implementation. Do not run remote or claim D1/D2/D3 from this config.
blocker.next_action: On an authorized Linux NVIDIA CUDA host, provision the pinned checkpoint and modified LIBERO-Spatial dataset revisions, implement/review the production OpenVLA capture adapter against the official Transformers API, then run the declared 500-trial paired intervention evaluation in a disposable checkout/cache.
